verdicts.title: Minimal spectral radius of graphs with given matching number
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
The Brualdi-Solheid problem asks which graph achieves the extremal (maximum or minimum) spectral radius for a given class of graphs. verdicts.title: New Lower Bounds for C4-Free Subgraphs of the Hypercubes Q6, Q7, and Q8: Constructions, Structure, and Computational Method
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We establish new lower bounds ex(Q_7,C_4)>=304 and ex(Q_8,C_4)>=680 for the maximum number of edges in a C_4-free subgraph of the 7- and 8-dimensional hypercubes, and give a modern computational reproduction of ex(Q_6,C_4)=132. All bounds are witnessed by explicit constructions certified by exhaustive enumeration of all four-cycles (240 for Q_6, 672 for Q_7, 1792 for Q_8).
